about_the_game:
Fervent: Sovereign Struggle immerses players in a dystopian world where gods rule over mortals, and power is the ultimate prize. In this third-person, story-driven action-adventure game, you step into the role of Omillah, a formidable deity determined to claim absolute dominion over the realm. However, the path to supremacy is filled with danger, as Omillah must confront his titanic siblings and force them to submit to his will.

Through epic battles, clever strategies, and delicate alliances, players will navigate a celestial conflict that shapes the future of gods and mortals alike. Omillah’s journey is as transformative as it is perilous, requiring players to shift between mortal, demigod, and divine forms to fulfill the ultimate prophecy.

Fervent Sovereign Struggle seamlessly combines narrative depth with dynamic gameplay, offering choices that influence the fate of both gods and mortals alike. Every decision has consequences, adding layers of complexity to the ongoing struggle for supreme rule. Only the strongest, wisest, and most resolute will emerge victorious in this clash of deities.

Current Features

  • As a shapeshifting deity, the player will take on 4 different classes each having their own strengths and drawbacks.

  • 7 distinct deities rule over different factions of people. All must be destroyed or made to yield and pledge alliance to the player.

  • Gaining Mana from battles will strengthen the players abilities and dexterity.

content_descriptors.notes: Fervent Sovereign Struggles is a story-driven action-adventure game that features intense violence involving a variety of weapons against both humans and creatures. Some sections of the game include scenes of torture and dismemberment, accompanied by high levels of blood and gore during combat. Crude language and alcohol consumption are prevalent throughout many levels of the game.
